expect: A TikTok/social media spat with Marks & Spencer drove huge free publicity.
value: Marks & Spencer sued Aldi over the cake, and the playful reply from Aldi won huge free publicity.
note: F1: the 2021 Cuthbert row began with an M&S High Court trade-mark claim (settled Feb 2022), not a TikTok spat.

find: When BrewDog set a 2030 carbon-negative target, it agreed to invest heavily in land restoration and renewable energy.
replace: When BrewDog set out to cut the carbon footprint of its Ellon brewery, it paid for biogas and anaerobic digestion plants.
note: F2: BrewDog had no 2030 carbon-negative target; it claimed to be carbon negative from 2020 and wound that claim down in 2024. Replaced with its verified Ellon brewery investment.

find: sales fell, share price dropped sharply, and the company commissioned an independent review
replace: its share price dropped sharply and the company commissioned an independent review
note: F3: Boohoo sales rose through 2020 (Q1 revenue +45%); the share price fell about 46%.

replace: Supermarkets charge at least 10p for carrier bags
note: F4: the England single-use carrier bag charge has been a minimum of 10p since 21 May 2021.

find: The exam will always ask you to weigh both sides.
replace: Exam questions on ethics usually ask you to weigh both sides.
note: F6: 'always' is an invented exam claim; 1-mark and 2-mark questions do not ask for both sides.

expect: Charging 5p for carrier bags (also: plastic-film takeback, reusable cup discounts).
value: Charging at least 10p for carrier bags (also: plastic-film takeback, reusable cup discounts).
note: F5: same 10p minimum charge as F4.

find: In 2022–2024 the Bank of England lifted interest rates from 0.1% to 5.25% to fight inflation.
replace: Between 2021 and 2023 the Bank of England lifted interest rates from 0.1% to 5.25% to fight inflation.
note: F7: rises ran from 15 Dec 2021 to 5.25% on 2 Aug 2023; 2024 brought cuts (5% by Aug 2024).

expect: Between 2022 and 2024, how far did the Bank of England raise its base rate?
value: Between 2021 and 2023, how far did the Bank of England raise its base rate?
note: F8: same date correction as F7.

replace: reaching 450 million customers in the EU
note: F10: EU population is about 452 million (1 Jan 2026), so 300 million understates the market.

expect: A UK holiday firm taking customers to Spain who pay in pounds
value: A UK hotel chain relying on visitors from the USA
note: F11: a strong pound also helps a UK holiday firm buying euro hotel rooms, so the old distractor was a second correct answer. New option is unambiguously bad news.

find: examiners want you to explain the effect on a business, not recite dates and section numbers
replace: the emphasis is on explaining the effect on a business, not on reciting dates and section numbers
note: F12: invented examiner claim; the point itself is spec-backed ('only brief knowledge of each law is needed').
